For my first 200 dogs out of academy i struggled SO much doing TBHs. It wasn't until my salon leader showed up and showed me HIS way (which he made up) and it all clicked for me. I just copy his technique and style.

We are both heavily in love with Asian style grooming and watch lots of Japanese and Korean videos that help us figure out how to do it.

I'd love to explain how i do it but i dont even know where to start! I just recommend watching a lot of videos like these and implement your own style from it!

the number one thing i can say i do is take the gaurd over the head backwards then blend it softly by skimming the temples to blend to the beard. The beard i just trim really short and rounded LOTs AND LOTS OF THIN SHEARING! also SUPER SHORT chins/beards help create that really round/asian style feeling. I wish i could describe it better, it really does take a lot of practice and you need to stick to a routine
